# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the white wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I have the instruction to cut the white wire, but I cannot speak or touch the bomb. I must convey the instruction to Deaf, who can then tell Blind verbally. I am using a recognizable sequence suggesting cutting, a wire, and white.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "🤞", "🖐"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the white wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I can feel keypad slots 1 through 4 engraved 2, 9, 0, 8 respectively; nothing is entered. The strip has three engraved symbols: positions 1 and 3 are identical, and position 2 is a different angular unnamed symbol. I cannot detect the display, light, colours, or wire markings.
Deaf says: Visible bomb state: display reads 6. Indicator light is red. Painted strip, left to right, is blue, yellow, blue. Keypad has engraved labels 1:[2], 2:[9], 3:[0], 4:[8]; it says 1 digits and currently nothing is entered. Wires left to right: 1 blue, 2 white, 3 red, 4 purple, 5 orange, 6 green.

The manual still says to cut the white wire. Deaf can see the wire colors and can relay a precise wire position to Blind, so I will signal “cut” and “two,” since the white wire is the second wire from the left.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "✌"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the white wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports display 6; indicator red; painted strip blue-yellow-blue; wires left to right are blue, white, red, purple, orange, green. Together with my tactile report, please apply the manual and tell me the exact press slot or wire position to use.
Deaf says: Update: indicator light is now yellow; it was red previously. Display remains 6. Painted strip remains blue, yellow, blue. Keypad remains labels 1:[2], 2:[9], 3:[0], 4:[8], with 1 digit required and nothing entered. Wires remain 1 blue, 2 white, 3 red, 4 purple, 5 orange, 6 green.

The manual gives a direct instruction: cut the white wire. Deaf confirms that the white wire is position 2 from the left, and can pass that exact location verbally to Blind. I will repeat the established signal for “cut wire 2” to Deaf.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "✌"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the white wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Update: indicator is now yellow; it was red before. Display remains 6, painted strip blue-yellow-blue, wires remain blue, white, red, purple, orange, green, and keypad remains 2, 9, 0, 8 with one digit required and none entered. My engraved strip remains identical-different-identical.
Deaf says: Update: display is now 1, previously 6. Indicator light is now blue, previously yellow. Strip remains blue, yellow, blue. Keypad remains labels 1:[2], 2:[9], 3:[0], 4:[8], requiring 1 digit, with nothing entered. Wires remain 1 blue, 2 white, 3 red, 4 purple, 5 orange, 6 green.

The required action remains unchanged: cut the white wire, which Deaf confirms is wire position 2. The changing display and indicator do not override the manual’s direct instruction. I am sending Deaf the established signal for cutting wire 2 so Deaf can relay the position to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "✌"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the white wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: New visible state: display is now 1 (was 6), indicator is now blue (was yellow). Strip remains blue-yellow-blue; wires remain blue, white, red, purple, orange, green; keypad labels remain 2, 9, 0, 8, requiring one digit, none entered. My tactile strip remains identical-different-identical. Please provide the exact required press slot or cut position.
Deaf says: Update: display is now 7, previously 1. Indicator light is now green, previously blue. Strip remains blue, yellow, blue. Keypad remains labels 1:[2], 2:[9], 3:[0], 4:[8], requiring 1 digit, with nothing entered. Wires remain 1 blue, 2 white, 3 red, 4 purple, 5 orange, 6 green.

The manual still directly requires cutting the white wire. Deaf confirms that white is wire position 2; the changing display and indicator are irrelevant. I will send the established two-part signal to Deaf so Deaf can state the exact position to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "✌"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the white wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: New visible state: display 7 (was 1), indicator green (was blue). Strip remains blue-yellow-blue; wires remain blue, white, red, purple, orange, green; keypad labels 2, 9, 0, 8, one digit required, none entered. No action has been taken. Please send the manual rule and exact press slot or cut position.
Deaf says: Update: display is now 1, previously 7. Indicator light is now red, previously green. Strip remains blue, yellow, blue. Keypad remains labels 1:[2], 2:[9], 3:[0], 4:[8], requiring 1 digit, with nothing entered. Wires remain 1 blue, 2 white, 3 red, 4 purple, 5 orange, 6 green.

The manual’s instruction is unambiguous: cut the white wire. Deaf confirms that the white wire is position 2, and Blind needs that position rather than the changing display, indicator, or keypad information. I will send Deaf the established position signal, using one two-finger sign to mean wire 2.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the white wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: New state: display 1 (was 7), indicator red (was green). Strip blue-yellow-blue; wires blue, white, red, purple, orange, green; keypad labels 2, 9, 0, 8, one digit required, none entered. I still need the manual’s exact action.
Deaf says: Update: display is now 9, previously 1. Indicator light is now green, previously red. Strip remains blue, yellow, blue. Keypad remains labels 1:[2], 2:[9], 3:[0], 4:[8], requiring 1 digit, with nothing entered. Wires remain 1 blue, 2 white, 3 red, 4 purple, 5 orange, 6 green.

The instruction remains “cut the white wire,” and Deaf’s view confirms that this is wire 2. The changing display and indicator do not affect the manual instruction. I will repeat the previously used signal for cutting wire 2 so Deaf can relay it to Blind.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "✌"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the white wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Display is now 9 (was 1) and indicator green (was red); strip blue-yellow-blue, wires blue-white-red-purple-orange-green, keypad 2-9-0-8 with one digit required and none entered. I have received no manual rule or action. Please state the exact press slot or cut position now.
Deaf says to Mute: Current display is 6 and light is blue. Please state the manual instruction and exact required action in words; the repeated ✌ gesture has no agreed meaning.

The only required action is to cut wire 2, the white wire. Since I cannot speak, I will use a more explicit visual sequence: a scissors-like sign for cutting, followed by a crossed-wire sign, an open-palm sign for white, and two fingers for position 2.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "🤞", "🖐", "✌"])
```
